rules.title: California tenant screening fee cap and requirements
rules.requirement: A landlord may charge a screening fee only up to the state maximum ($68.96 for 2026), must give a receipt, an itemized list of costs, a copy of the credit report and a refund of any unused portion, and cannot charge a fee if no unit is available.
rules.requirement_es: El arrendador solo puede cobrar una tarifa de evaluación hasta el máximo estatal ($68.96 en 2026), y debe dar un recibo, una lista detallada de gastos, una copia del informe de crédito y reembolsar cualquier parte no utilizada; no puede cobrar la tarifa si no hay una unidad disponible.
rules.quoted_span: Prospective tenants should expect to receive a copy of their credit report within 7 days of receipt by the landlord, a receipt for the fee paid and an itemized list of any out-of-pocket expenses and time spent by the landlord on the screening, and a refund of any unused portion of the fee.
rules.caveat: Secondary explanation on a city page; the cap is adjusted annually for inflation.

rules.title: Berkeley screening fee rights notice requirement
rules.requirement: Before taking a screening fee, a Berkeley landlord must give applicants a clear and conspicuous tenant screening fee rights statement and a statement of the state maximum fee cap, either in the application or in a separate disclosure.
rules.requirement_es: Antes de cobrar una tarifa de evaluación, el arrendador en Berkeley debe entregar al solicitante una declaración clara y visible de sus derechos sobre la tarifa y del límite máximo estatal, en la solicitud o en un aviso separado.

rules.title: Berkeley ban on non-refundable fees for existing tenancies
rules.requirement: A Berkeley landlord cannot charge an existing tenant a non-refundable fee to renew a tenancy, including fees for a roommate leaving or being added or replaced.
rules.requirement_es: El arrendador en Berkeley no puede cobrar a un inquilino actual una tarifa no reembolsable para renovar el contrato, incluidas las tarifas por la salida, adición o reemplazo de un compañero de cuarto.
rules.quoted_span: An owner of residential rental property (or the owner’s agent) cannot charge a non-refundable fee to any existing tenant for the purpose of renewing a tenancy, in whole or in part
